title: The Crooked Badge
description: The sergeant finally says it plain: the rot wears his own uniform. Half the precinct answers to the Syndicate, and the Constables on the take have started riding with a Torpedo for muscle — a death squad with a badge. He can't arrest them; the ones who'd do the arresting are them. So he's done arresting. Clear the crooked badges off his street and he'll stop looking the other way for good.
location_hint: Constabulary steps and the precinct back lot, Ashmoor

objectives.desc: Put down the Constables on the take
Kill the Torpedo riding with them
